predefinedQueries.queryString: select true as insert_missing_mins, true as segna_ferie, true as segna_permesso, csn.date_time_begin::date, an.dynamo_user, entrasp.dynamo_employer(an.dynamo_user) as employer, sum(csn.durata) as minuti_rendicontati, entrasp.minuti_richiesti_user(an.dynamo_user, csn.date_time_begin::date) as minuti_richiesti, greatest(0,(entrasp.minuti_richiesti_user(an.dynamo_user, csn.date_time_begin::date)- sum(csn.durata))) as minuti_mancanti from entrasp.consuntivazioni csn inner join entrasp.anagrafiche_id an on csn.id_risorsa=an.id_anagrafica and csn.codice_part=an.codice_part and an.dynamo_user in(select entrasp.colleghi('€global_username€')) where csn.date_time_begin<=current_date  and csn.date_time_begin>'2021-01-01'
update entrasp.consuntivazioni cn set codice_part=az.codice_part from entrasp.aziende az where cn.codice_azienda=az.codice_azienda and cn.codice_part is null and cn.codice_azienda=$codice_azienda$
update entrasp.consuntivazioni cn set codice_part=az.codice_part from entrasp.aziende az where cn.codice_azienda=az.codice_azienda and cn.codice_part is null and cn.codice_azienda=$codice_azienda$
update entrasp.consuntivazioni cn set codice_part=az.codice_part from entrasp.aziende az where cn.codice_azienda=az.codice_azienda and cn.codice_part is null and cn.codice_azienda=$codice_azienda$

toolbar_elements.label: Miei
toolbar_elements.comboQuery: select distinct dynamo_user as id, dynamo_user as name from entrasp.employers where dynamo_user in(select distinct em2.dynamo_user from entrasp.employers em2 where em2.codice_azienda in (select em3.codice_azienda from entrasp.employers em3 where em3.dynamo_user='€global_username€'));

content.query: select count(tr_inc.dynamo_user) from (select an.dynamo_user, csn.date_time_begin::date from entrasp.consuntivazioni csn inner join entrasp.anagrafiche_id an on csn.id_risorsa=an.id_anagrafica and csn.codice_part=an.codice_part and an.dynamo_user in(select entrasp.colleghi('€global_username€')) where csn.date_time_begin<=current_date  and csn.date_time_begin>'2021-01-01' group by an.dynamo_user, csn.date_time_begin::date having greatest(0,(entrasp.minuti_richiesti_user(an.dynamo_user, csn.date_time_begin::date)- sum(csn.durata)))>0) tr_inc WHERE true

menuOptions.label: Aggiungi minuti mancanti utente corrente
menuOptions.query: select entrasp.inserisci_ferie(csn.date_time_begin::date, em.codice_azienda, tr_inc.dynamo_user, csn.date_time_begin::date +interval '1080 minutes', csn.date_time_begin::date + interval '1080 minutes' + (greatest(0,(entrasp.minuti_richiesti_user(an.dynamo_user, csn.date_time_begin::date)- sum(csn.durata))))*interval '1 minute') from entrasp.consuntivazioni csn inner join entrasp.anagrafiche_id an on csn.id_risorsa=an.id_anagrafica and csn.codice_part=an.codice_part and an.dynamo_user in(select entrasp.colleghi('€global_username€')) where csn.date_time_begin<=current_date  and csn.date_time_begin>'2021-01-01';

format.comboQuery: select distinct dynamo_user as id, dynamo_user as name from entrasp.employers where dynamo_user in(select distinct em2.dynamo_user from entrasp.employers em2 where em2.codice_azienda in (select em3.codice_azienda from entrasp.employers em3 where em3.dynamo_user='€global_username€'));

querySuffixes.tableViewSuffix: group by csn.date_time_begin::date, an.dynamo_user, entrasp.dynamo_employer(an.dynamo_user) having greatest(0,(entrasp.minuti_richiesti_user(an.dynamo_user, csn.date_time_begin::date)- sum(csn.durata)))>0 order by csn.date_time_begin::date
